notes: Pendant matches listing photo 0 closely. One cushion-cut clear CZ with 4 prongs counted (back ~(467,1514), left ~(381,1601), front ~(515,1655), right ~(597,1566)). The open-window basket and the tube bail are threaded on a round silver snake chain. Closure matches the real piece: end cap, curb extender, lobster, blank bar tag, end cap.
Stone colour is neutral. The stone region (380-590, 1530-1690) has 0% warm/amber pixels (mean R-B about 4). No glow, unlike the earlier S1_a1.

Scale is OK. The camera sits at about 40 degrees: the stone's top shows as a parallelogram, which gives a y-compression of about 0.63. After correcting for that, the stone is about 160-175 px wide and the chain about 31 px (ratio about 5.3, listing 10mm/2mm = 5). The corrected lavender spike is about 615 px, which gives about 15.4 px/mm, so the stone reads about 10-11 mm and the chain about 2 mm. Scaling from the florets gives about 9-10 mm. Both are within 30%.

The back of the coil (y about 980-1250) is out of focus. The three strands cross cleanly with no visible break or loose end, and a single-chain path is possible, but full continuity can't be traced through the blur.
A soft beige out-of-focus background shape sits at the top edge (x about 1080-1300, y 0-80). It is not jewellery or text, and the layout can crop it.
The lilac torn-paper set reads clearly lilac. No text, logo or watermark in the frame or corners. The pendant is small in the 9:16 frame and there is plenty of copy space (composition only).

Crop checked: this is a pixel-exact crop of S2_a2 at offset (191,460). In the original the chin and jawline end above y of about 420, so no chin, lips, nose, eye or ear is in frame. Only neck and a few hair wisps (top-right corner) are visible.

Pendant: cushion-cut clear stone with 4 prongs (TL, TR, BL, BR), a window basket, and a tube bail on a continuous snake chain. The chain wraps behind the neck on both sides. Stone colour is neutral: mean R-B about 5. The 2% warm pixels are skin seen through the stone; real worn photo 1 shows 4.8%.

Scale is borderline large but within tolerance. The stone is about 115 px wide at (598-725, 1027-1150) and the chain about 18.5 px (ratio about 6.2 vs 5 listed). Stone-to-neck width is 0.131 here (neck 880 px at the top edge) vs 0.116 in real worn photo 1, so the stone reads about 13-25% larger than in the real listing photo. The chain itself reads about 2.1-2.3 mm against the neck. A reshoot should not go any bigger.
The lilac linen shirt and lilac-grey wall read lilac.

Macro matches the listing: one cushion-cut clear CZ with 4 prongs (back ~(606,1245), left ~(370,1445), front ~(674,1565), right ~(898,1353)), an open window basket, and a tube bail with the snake chain through it. The snake chain is crisp. The stone-to-chain ratio (about 440 px / 90 px, about 4.9) is consistent with a 10mm stone on a 2mm chain.

The basket windows render see-through (fabric shows through them) rather than the frosty pavilion sparkle seen in listing photo 0. This is a minor rendering difference; the construction is the same.
Clasp and extender at the top right are in soft focus (depth of field), not garbled.

The metal picks up a lilac cast from the fabric (chain mean RGB about 164/146/152, G < B) but still reads as silver, not rose gold. There is no listed size referent in frame. The lilac knit reads lilac. No text.

One necklace in two interlocking loops. The chain traces as one continuous path: end cap 1, right loop, through the bail at ~(770,1720), left loop, end cap 2 at ~(1245,1395). There is a single clean crossing at ~(1200,990). Closure matches the real piece: end cap, jump ring, curb extender (about 9 links), lobster, jump ring, bar tag with round holes, jump ring, end cap.

Pendant: cushion-cut clear CZ with 4 prongs (top ~(668,1712), right ~(772,1768), bottom ~(718,1868), left ~(608,1808)), a window basket, and a tube bail on the snake chain. Stone has 0% warm pixels. It rests on the paper with a cast shadow, and the lavender lies over the chain, which is plausible.

Scale is borderline small against the lavender. The spike runs from ~(1125,1868) to ~(1600,1300), about 720-765 px, and the florets are about 65-90 px, which gives about 19 px/mm at 40mm/4mm. The stone is about 130-145 px wide, so it reads about 7-7.5 mm (about -25 to -30%), and the 24.5 px chain reads about 1.3 mm. The product is consistent within itself: stone-to-chain about 5.5, and the chain path is about 4600 px, about 37 cm at its own scale. So the sprig is simply large. This is at the limit and not failed; a reshoot should use a sprig about 4x the stone width.
The handmade lilac paper and backdrop read lilac. The flecks in the paper are petal inclusions, not text. No watermark.
